tp_search_summary: Grepped every .ts/.js/.mjs/.cjs file in the repo (excluding node_modules) for `.closed`, `['closed']` and "closed". The only hits are in packages/puppeteer-core/src/bidi: Browser.ts:259 (this.connection.closed, the Connection type), CDPSession.ts:98 (#connection.closed), Frame.ts:469 (browsingContext.closed, the core BrowsingContext), the own-class this.closed reads in core/Browser.ts, BrowsingContext.ts, UserContext.ts and UserPrompt.ts, and Connection.test.ts (a mock transport field). None has an api/BrowserContext receiver, and nothing in tests/ or examples reads context.closed.
rationale: The `closed` getter on api/BrowserContext is public API surface for external consumers only. Every in-repo `.closed` access resolves to a same-named member on Connection, BrowsingContext, UserContext, UserPrompt, the bidi core Browser, or a test mock transport, never to a BrowserContext instance.
prior_verdicts_assessment: The prior tp verdict is correct; the name collisions it cites are real and none reaches this getter.
